newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1997 nickel output seen at 46,000 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: China 1997 nickel output seen at 46,000 tonnes.

text.p: China's nickel production is expected to reach 46,000 tonnes in 1997, the official Economic Daily said on Thursday.
The newspaper did not give comparative figures.
Jinchuan Nonferrous Co in northwestern China's Gansu province, the nation's largest producer, is expected to produce 40,000 tonnes of nickel in 1997, up from 38,000 tonnes in 1996, it said.
Domestic nickel demand from stainless steel makers is expected to hit 37,000 tonnes and demand from electroplating firms and producers of steel alloys is projected at 15,000 tonnes, it said.

China's high export duties on nickel have made it difficult for producers to export while rising imports of foreign products have hit the domestic market, it said without giving further details. -- Beijing Newsroom (8610) 6532 1921
